description: This file contains implementation of big number addition functions, including BN_add, BN_uadd, BN_usub, and BN_sub, for arbitrary precision arithmetic in cryptographic operations.

methods.name: BN_add
methods.description: Performs addition of two big numbers, handling sign logic.

methods.name: BN_uadd
methods.description: Performs unsigned addition of two big numbers.

methods.name: BN_usub
methods.description: Performs unsigned subtraction of two big numbers, assuming the first is larger.

methods.name: BN_sub
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two big numbers, handling sign logic.
